newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia state premier slams Wik land decision.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia state premier slams Wik land decision.

text.p: Western Australian Premier Richard Court said on Monday the Wik decision had done nothing to remove the uncertainty about the relationship between native title and existing rights of landholders.

Court said the uncertainty was strangling development in regional Australia and renewed his call for the Native Title Act to be amended to ensure the rights of all leasholders prevail over native title rights where there is inconsistency.
"The Federal Government must take urgent legislative action to remove the doubt and provide certainty to the existing interests of pastoral leaseholders," he said.

"Failure to do this will leave State governments, existing landholders and indigenous Australians with no option but to resort to the Courts time and time again in attempts to establish the relationship between native title claims and existing interests," he said.
"It is now three years since the Native Title Act was proclaimed and there is in fact greater uncertainty and doubt than there was before the Act was passed.
"Public reserves, private leashold, roads, public works and even freehold land are now being claimed, something that we were promised could not happen."
